shellCommands.command:
cd /workspace && node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/
echo ""
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -20

cd /workspace && \
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d "title=The%20Great%20Gatsby&author=F.%20Scott%20Fitzgerald&notes=A%20classic%20about%20the%20Jazz%20Age." -L -o /tmp/book.html -w "redirect: %{url_effective}\n" && \
BOOK_ID=$(grep -oP '/books/[a-f0-9-]+' /workspace/data/books.json | head -1 | cut -d/ -f2 || node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)") && \
BOOK_ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)") && \
echo "Book ID: $BOOK_ID" && \
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID" | grep -E "detail-title|detail-author|notes-content" && \
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID/finish" -L -o /dev/null -w "finish redirect: %{url_effective}\n" && \
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -c "Finished" && \
cat data/books.json

pkill -f "node server.js" 2>/dev/null; cd /workspace && node server.js &
sleep 0.5
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/

cd /workspace && node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
